summary: Mudrex Earn is a centralized crypto yield feature launched in June 2024 for supported assets, with current Mudrex material continuing to list Earn Products.
what_happened: Mudrex launched Earn on 2024-06-11 and announced the migration of legacy Vault users into Earn later that month. Reviewed first-party materials describe staking-oriented mechanics for some assets and later material also discusses lending, so no single yield mechanism is generalized across all assets.
uncertainty_notes: Product mechanics vary by supported asset. Reviewed sources do not establish one universal legal-title, segregation, insolvency-priority or yield-source model across all Earn assets.
